history.content: I rebooted the device as you asked, but I still have no signal at all—no bars, no 5G, and I can't get online or send picture messages.

Thank you for letting me know. Since your line is now active but you still have no signal, let’s do some troubleshooting steps to identify the cause.

Could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know what icons or messages you see at the top of your screen? Specifically, let me know if you see any of the following:
- Airplane mode icon
- “No Signal” or “No Service” message
- SIM card error or missing SIM icon

This information will help me guide you through the next steps.
Now I see signal bars showing Excellent, 5G, and Data Enabled at the top of my screen. It says I'm connected to Chestnut-5G and my battery is at 87%.

That’s great news! Your phone is now showing excellent signal strength, 5G connectivity, and mobile data is enabled. This means your service has been fully restored.

You should now be able to make calls, get online, and send picture messages (MMS) as usual. If you experience any further issues with your service or messaging, please let me know and I’ll be happy to assist you further.
